script_text: Love and money collide this week, Taurus; earth-sign steadiness cannot erase the tension. For Mon–Wed, Venus, your ruler, occupies the 7th House: prioritize partners whose behavior matches their promises. Mercury is retrograde there; carefully reread salary and bonus terms before responding. The key shift is Saturday’s full Moon in the 11th opposing your 1st-house Sun: salary negotiations demand faster decisions. Thursday’s Sun trines Pluto in the 9th, giving you clearer boundaries; Friday favors bold introductions. Saturday’s Moon-Pluto square can inflame old money arguments; Sunday rewards a quieter, fact-based review. Wednesday is your power day as Venus in the 7th sextiles Jupiter in the 3rd, ideal for relationship clarity and money negotiations. Saturday is your friction day because that 11th-house full Moon challenges your 1st-house boundaries, especially when money and status collide. Keep every promise realistic: confirm the numbers, then sleep before replying. Follow for daily updates.
